what: Hook count parity: ALL count-related fields (scoped_count, scoped_ids, layers breakdown, topics) in scripts/hooks/recall-for-path.js now derive from a single source of truth — computeScopedForPath() in src/memory/recall.ts. That helper applies the focused-scope filter (exact file + immediate parent + deeper, NO grandparent, NO project-wide) in one place. If you change the blocking-scope rule, update computeScopedForPath and every hook count updates automatically. Guarded by hooks.test.ts parity test + scripts/hooks/__tests__/count-parity.sh smoke test.
why: Prevents drift between the integer nudge ("N memories not yet recalled") and the layer breakdown preview. Validation on /tmp/aide-l-test showed integer=2 while preview summed to 4 because the two were computed from different filters.
